nodes.description: Address with privileged control; set to msg.sender in constructor and used by whenOwner modifier and selfdestruct.
Mapping(address=>uint) of pending player balances; credited in calcWinner and drained in userWithdraw.
Current round counter, incremented in userRegister and used to index participants.
Number of players registered in the current round; drives calcWinner branching.
Mapping(uint=>address[15]) of players per round; written in userRegister and calcWinner.
Initializes owner = msg.sender, round = 1 and registered = 0.
Owner-only function transferring an arbitrary amount of contract balance to owner.
Owner-only function calling selfdestruct(owner).
View getter returning the current round.
View getter returning the 15 participants of a given round index.
View getter returning the withdrawals balance of a given player.
Public function that zeroes the caller's withdrawal balance then transfers it to msg.sender.
Payable public entry point requiring 105 finney, records the sender and triggers calcWinner logic.
Private function picking a pseudo-random winner from blockhash and participant addresses, crediting withdrawals.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, registration and payout destination.
owner.transfer(amount) - raw balance transfer to the owner address.
selfdestruct(owner) - irreversible destruction sending all balance to owner.
msg.sender.transfer(amount) - external call to an untrusted address, reentrancy sink.
withdrawals[participant] += reward - unchecked arithmetic credit on 0.4.22 with no SafeMath.
amount parameter of ownerWithdraw, arbitrary value chosen by the owner.
index parameter of publicGetParticipants selecting the round array.
player parameter of publicGetBalance used to read the withdrawals mapping.
first parameter of calcWinner, participant index of the first contender.
second parameter of calcWinner, participant index of the second contender.
winner parameter of calcWinner, slot where the winner address is stored.
reward parameter of calcWinner, amount credited to the winner's withdrawals balance.
local random value derived from blockhash(block.number-1) plus participant addresses; weak randomness source.
local amount in userWithdraw caching withdrawals[msg.sender] before transfer.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
msg.sender is read during construction to set the owner.
Constructor initializes round = 1.
Constructor initializes registered = 0.
ownerWithdraw receives the amount parameter it forwards to transfer.
The amount parameter flows directly into owner.transfer(amount).
whenOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner, gating privileged withdrawal.
ownerDestroy is the only caller of selfdestruct(owner).
whenOwner modifier gates the selfdestruct with msg.sender == owner.
publicGetRound returns the round state variable.
publicGetParticipants reads participants[index] where index is user supplied.
The index parameter selects which round array is returned.
publicGetBalance reads withdrawals[player].
The player parameter selects the withdrawals entry to read.
userWithdraw reads then zeroes withdrawals[msg.sender].
userWithdraw uses msg.sender both as the balance key and the transfer recipient.
The cached local amount is loaded from withdrawals[msg.sender].
The cached amount is sent to msg.sender via an external call after state is cleared.
userWithdraw performs an external value transfer to an untrusted address.
msg.sender.transfer can invoke a fallback that reenters userWithdraw; state is zeroed first so re-mint is mitigated but the callback edge exists.
userRegister stores and logs msg.sender as a participant.
userRegister writes participants[round][registered] = msg.sender.
userRegister reads and increments the registered counter.
userRegister increments round when the round is full.
userRegister calls calcWinner conditionally based on the registered counter.
calcWinner uses the first index to read participants[round][first].
calcWinner uses the second index to read participants[round][second].
calcWinner writes the selected address into participants[round][winner].
calcWinner credits the reward parameter into the winner balance.
calcWinner reads and mutates the participants mapping.
calcWinner derives its local random value from blockhash and participant addresses.
random parity selects the branch that performs unchecked credit.
calcWinner executes withdrawals[..] += reward without overflow protection.
Unchecked addition mutates the withdrawals balance mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter has no independent semantics outside the function that forwards it to owner.transfer.
The index parameter only selects the participants array inside publicGetParticipants.
The player parameter only selects the withdrawals entry inside publicGetBalance.
first is an internal index argument of calcWinner and carries no standalone meaning.
second is an internal index argument of calcWinner and carries no standalone meaning.
winner is an internal storage slot argument of calcWinner.
reward is an internal payout amount argument of calcWinner.
The local random value exists only to choose the branch that performs the unchecked withdrawals credit.
The cached local amount exists only to be passed into msg.sender.transfer.
